scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:demo
scripts.build:lib: ng build ngx-command-palette && cp README.md LICENSE dist/ngx-command-palette/
scripts.format: prettier --write --log-level warn README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md angular.json package.json tsconfig.json projects e2e .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --log-level warn README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md angular.json package.json tsconfig.json projects e2e .github
scripts.format:changed: (git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR HEAD; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard) | xargs -r prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn
